{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Xenodetic Survey department''' was an department of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A recording [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]] in the department changed an entry on the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], modifying the name of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] 96NK3F2 to [[Fiddanl]]. "Fiddanl" was a popular pet name among the [[Nuiwit]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
